validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.35 Selective Escalation Calibration with reproducible governed routing and explicit evidence boundaries.
scope: Extend calibration-report with reusable route policies, pair-level route decisions, route execution evidence, route assessments, governance, and verifier boundaries.
Add deterministic verifier rules, retained negative fixtures, examples, plain-language docs, roadmap, changelog, runtime log, and release evidence.
constraints: Do not infer authority, causality, competence, quality, or semantic truth from route selection, execution, outcome, or count.
expected_outcomes: Users can reproduce why a route was selected and whether actual execution matched the governed policy.
Unresolved authority, mismatch, failed escalated outcomes, unverified evidence, and insufficient samples become visible governance work.
